title: CTIS Report
description: CTEM Interchange Schema (CTIS) - Standard format for exchanging assets, findings and dependencies between security tools and platforms. Normative field semantics: docs/spec.md in https://github.com/openctemio/ctis

version.description: CTIS specification version as MAJOR.MINOR. Receivers decode a document of their own or an older minor strictly, ignore unknown members and map unknown enum values to their fallback in a document of a newer minor, and refuse another major (docs/spec.md section 2.2). The default is the version this schema describes.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for validation, normally https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openctemio/ctis/main/schemas/v1/report.json

relationships.description: Typed relationships between two assets of this report, named by their ids (1.5)

endpoints.description: Methods and paths web origins serve, as a tool saw them (1.6); parameters are named, never valued

Extensions.description: Namespaced producer data (2.0): keys are reverse-DNS namespaces (io.openctem, com.example.scanner), values objects that namespace defines. A receiver validates a namespace it knows and ignores one it does not. At most 32 namespaces and 64 KiB serialized (the size is checked by Validate).

TargetOutcome.description: How one target of the work ended (2.0), in the vocabulary of the outcome package: done and unfinished take no class or cause; failed and skipped need a class of their own

target.description: The target as the work was given it (a name, an address, a range, a URL)

Segment.description: This document's place in a result split over count documents that share one metadata.id (2.0). index is zero-based.

Relationship.description: A typed edge between two different assets of the report

from_ref.description: Id of the source asset in this report

to_ref.description: Id of the target asset in this report

first_seen_at.description: When the producer first observed the edge (2.0)

last_seen_at.description: When the producer last observed the edge (2.0)

confidence.description: How sure the producer is of the edge, 0-100 (2.0)

RelationshipType.description: One direction per type, read as from <type> to; no inverse duplicates

coverage_type.description: Coverage type: full (complete scan), incremental (diff scan), partial (specific directories)

capability.description: The capability this report answers, as id@major (scan.ports@1). A producer claim; receivers that bound the report to a command use the command's capability (1.5)

started_at.description: When the work that produced the report started (2.0)

ended_at.description: When the work that produced the report ended (2.0)

targets.description: How each target of the work ended (2.0). An item seen earlier on target T is gone only when a coverage_type full report lists T with state done and omits it

BranchInfo.description: Git branch context for CI/CD scans. Used for branch-aware finding lifecycle management.

is_default_branch.description: Whether this is the default branch (main/master). Auto-resolve only applies to default branch scans.

base_branch.description: Base branch for PR/MR scans (e.g., 'main' when scanning a PR targeting main)

pull_request_number.description: PR/MR number if this is a pull request scan

pull_request_url.description: PR/MR URL if this is a pull request scan

repository_url.description: Repository URL for context. Format: domain/owner/repo (e.g., github.com/org/repo)

capabilities.description: What the tool does. OpenCTEM derives a report's detection technique from the first value it recognises (sast, sca, dast, secret, iac, container, va, easm, cspm, external, import, misconfiguration, web3, subdomain, dns, portscan, crawler, tech-detect) and falls back to the tool name.

Properties.description: Custom properties: an opaque bag. Receivers SHOULD NOT give meaning to its keys; namespaced data goes in extensions (2.0)
